cases.situation: Going to Lisbon Oct 10 to 17 and need someone to feed my cat Miso once a day, about ten minutes for food, water and the litter tray. Want to ask my neighbour Tom, we chat in the hallway but aren't close. I'm Hana in 3B, and if he can't I'll book a sitter.
cases.reply: Hi Tom, it's Hana from 3B. I'm away 10 to 17 October and wondered if you could feed Miso once a day while I'm gone. It's about ten minutes: food, water and a quick scoop of the litter tray. I'd drop the key and a short list round on the 9th. If that week's no good, no problem at all, I'll book a sitter.
cases.note: With someone you're not close to, naming the exact size of the job is what makes a yes easy.

cases.situation: The boiler engineer is coming to my flat at 4pm today, a one-hour job, and I'm stuck at work until 7. My friend Nell lives on my street and has my spare key. If she can't, I'll ring them and rebook for Saturday.
cases.reply: Hi Nell, a last-minute ask, so tell me straight if it doesn't work: the boiler engineer is due at mine at 4pm today and I'm stuck at work until 7. Could you use the spare key to let him in and lock up when he's done? It's about an hour. If you're busy, no problem at all, I'll ring them and rebook for Saturday.
cases.note: On short notice, put the time pressure up front and make the out even easier, because they have no time to plan around a no.

cases.situation: Preciso pedir pro meu amigo Rafa, que tem carro grande, pra me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado de manhã. O sofá não cabe em carro pequeno e deve levar umas duas horas com trânsito; se ele não puder, eu chamo um frete, e quero pagar o almoço dele.
cases.reply: Rafa, pedido sincero: você toparia me ajudar a levar um sofá de Pinheiros até a Mooca no sábado de manhã? Umas duas horas contando o trânsito, e precisa do seu carro porque o sofá não cabe em carro pequeno. Se não der, de boa, eu chamo um frete. O almoço é por minha conta de qualquer jeito.
cases.note: O custo, duas horas e o carro dele, vem logo de cara, para ele não topar algo maior do que imaginava.

cases.situation: 我爸妈10月24日（周六）晚上在家办结婚三十周年的小聚会，大概20个亲戚。朋友阿杰业余拍照拍得特别好，想请他6点半到7点半来拍一个小时，照片导出来给我就行，不用修图。他不方便的话，我就自己用手机拍。
cases.reply: 阿杰，想请你帮个忙，正好是你最拿手的：10月24日周六晚上我爸妈在家办结婚三十周年的小聚会，二十来个亲戚，想请你来帮忙拍照，6点半到7点半，大概一个小时。照片导出来给我就行，不用修图。那天要是有安排，或者周末只想歇着，直接说就好，我自己拿手机拍也行。
cases.note: 找人做他擅长的事，直接说为什么找他；同时把范围卡住（一小时、不修图），别让爱好变成一份活。

cases.situation: I start a new job on Monday but my first paycheck doesn't arrive until October 30, and rent ($1,650) is due Thursday. I want to ask my older sister Mei to lend me $2,000 for rent and groceries and pay it back on October 31. I've never borrowed from her before.
cases.reply: Hi Mei, bit of an awkward ask, so I'll just say it. My new job starts Monday but the first paycheck doesn't land until 30 October, and rent is due on Thursday. Could you lend me $2,000 to cover rent and groceries until then? I'd pay it all back on 31 October and set up the transfer that day so you never have to chase me. Totally fine to say no if it's a stretch right now.
cases.note: Money from family: exact amount, exact repayment date, and an out that doesn't need a reason.

cases.situation: 上周五在微信上问朋友小陈，10月10号到11号周末我去露营，能不能借他的四人帐篷，他一直没回。不行的话我就去租一顶，想让他周三前给个准话。
cases.reply: 小陈，上周问你10月10号到11号借帐篷的事，你那边不方便的话完全没关系，麻烦周三前跟我说一声就行，我好去租一顶。
cases.note: 没回复时跟进一次，重申退路，给一个明确的回复时间；如果还是没回，就当作不行，去租。

cases.situation: My friend Marcus said he'd help me move tomorrow morning with his truck. He just texted that he can't make it, his daughter Ellie has a fever. I can book a van instead; I'm stressed and a bit annoyed but I don't want to guilt-trip him.
cases.reply: Oh no, hope Ellie's fever breaks soon. No problem at all, I'll book a van for the morning. Give her a hug from me.
cases.note: When a yes turns into a late no, absorb it in one line. No guilt trip keeps the door open for the next favour, in either direction.

cases.situation: I have a job interview in Chicago on Wednesday Oct 14 and hotels are $250 a night. My college friend Amara lives there, we haven't seen each other in a year. Want to ask if I can crash on her couch Tuesday and Wednesday nights; I fly home Thursday morning and I'd love to take her to dinner Wednesday.
cases.reply: Hi Amara! I've got an interview in Chicago on Wednesday 14 October, and I wondered if I could crash on your couch the Tuesday and Wednesday nights, 13 and 14. I'd be out most of Wednesday and heading to the airport Thursday morning, so I'd barely be in your way. Totally fine if it's a bad week, I'll book a hotel, no problem. Either way, dinner's on me Wednesday night, I'd love to catch up.
cases.note: Name the exact nights and how little space you'll take, give a real out, and offer something you'd genuinely want to do anyway.

cases.situation: My friend Dana is a commercial property lawyer. I'm about to sign a 4-page, 3-year lease for my bakery and want her to spend maybe 30 minutes looking it over before Friday Oct 9. I don't want to take advantage of her just because we're friends, so I'm happy to pay her rate, and dinner's on me either way.
cases.reply: Hi Dana, you're the only lawyer I know who does commercial leases, so I'm going to ask: would you have 30 minutes before Friday Oct 9 to skim the 4-page lease for the bakery and flag anything that would worry you? Not a full review, just 'I'd push back on this clause'. If you'd rather keep work and friends separate, or you'd want to bill it as a normal job, say so, both are completely fine. Dinner's on me either way.
cases.note: When the favour is someone's profession, keep the scope narrow and make paying or declining as easy as saying yes.

cases.situation: 我在火锅店做服务员，10月10号周六是我的晚班，那天我表妹订婚，想去。想问同事小敏能不能跟我换班，她下周二10月13号是早班，我可以替她上。周六晚上人多挺累的，想让她周四前回我。
cases.reply: 小敏，想请你帮个忙：10月10号周六的晚班你能跟我换吗？那天我表妹订婚。你13号周二的早班我来上，你那天能睡个懒觉。周六晚上人多挺累的，不方便就直说，我再问问别人。周四前告诉我就行。
cases.note: 换班请求把日期、代价（周六晚班累）和回报一次说清，再给一个真的出口和答复期限。

cases.situation: I'm on night shifts at the hospital from Oct 12 to Oct 30, so I can't do the 5pm Tuesday and Thursday run to football practice for my son Eli (9). Want to ask the other parents in the team WhatsApp group if anyone can pick him up from the Ashgrove Primary gate at 4:45. Otherwise I'll book the after-school club, and once I'm back on days I can take a carful on Saturdays.
cases.reply: Hi all, a practical ask: I'm on night shifts from 12 to 30 October, so I can't do the 5pm run to Tuesday and Thursday practice for Eli. Could anyone with a spare seat pick him up from the Ashgrove Primary gate at 4:45 on one of those days? It's six sessions in total, so even one or two would help a lot. No worries if the timing doesn't work, I'll book the after-school club otherwise. Once I'm back on days I'm happy to take a carful on Saturdays.
cases.note: In a group ask, split the favour into small pieces so people can offer one slot without signing up for all six.

cases.situation: I manage a team of six. We need two people to help staff our stand at a home show on Saturday Oct 17, 9am to 3pm, mostly chatting to visitors on our feet all day; travel's paid, there's a day off in lieu, and I need names by Friday Oct 9 or I'll book temp staff. It's not in anyone's contract and I want it to be genuinely optional, not the kind of 'volunteer' everyone knows is mandatory.
cases.reply: Hi team, a genuinely optional ask: I need two people to help me run our stand at the home show on Saturday 17 October, 9am to 3pm. It's mostly chatting to visitors, on your feet most of the day, with travel paid. Anyone who does it gets a full day off in lieu, on a date of their choosing. If nobody fancies it, that's completely fine, it won't come up at review time and I'll book temp staff instead. Message me privately by Friday 9 October if you're up for it.
cases.note: When you have power over the person, the out has to be explicit, and private replies mean nobody feels watched saying no.

cases.situation: I'm an ICU nurse thinking about moving into UX research. I found Jordan Lee on LinkedIn, a UX researcher at Carewell, a health-tech company, who used to be a nurse too. We've never met; I want to ask for a 20-minute call, mainly about how Jordan landed a first research role.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, I'm an ICU nurse looking at a move into UX research, and your path from nursing into research at Carewell is the closest match to mine I've found. Would you be open to a 20-minute video call sometime in the next few weeks? I'd mainly love to hear how you landed your first research role, and I'll fit around your schedule. If you're too busy, no problem at all, and thanks for reading this either way.
cases.note: A stranger owes you nothing: say why them, cap the time, and make ignoring the message painless.

cases.situation: 上个月表哥刚帮我搬了家。现在我妈10月14号周三下午3点到南京南站，我那天在合肥出差赶不回来，想再请表哥去接一下，送到我家，来回大概一个半小时。他不方便的话我就给我妈叫个专车，回来想请他吃饭。
cases.reply: 哥，上个月刚麻烦你帮我搬家，这次又要开口：我妈10月14号周三下午3点到南京南站，我那天在合肥出差赶不回来，想请你去接一下，送到我家，来回大概一个半小时。那天要是上班走不开，完全没关系，直接跟我说，我给她叫个专车就行。等我回来，请你吃饭。
cases.note: 连着第二次找同一个人帮忙，提一句上次的情分，把退路说得具体，让他拒绝也不为难。

cases.situation: I'm Ana, and my partner Sam turns 40 on Saturday 24 October; I'm throwing a surprise party at home. I want to ask Sam's best friend Leo, who I've only met a few times, to take Sam out from 2pm to 5pm that day so I can set up. If he can't, my sister will do it.
cases.reply: Hi Leo, it's Ana, Sam's partner. I'm throwing Sam a surprise 40th at home on Saturday 24 October, and I'd love your help with the hardest part: could you get Sam out of the house from 2pm to 5pm that day so I can set up? Anything you'd normally do together is perfect, and please keep it between us. If you're busy or it's not your thing, no problem at all, my sister can do it.
cases.note: When the favour comes with a secret, say so plainly and give the whole job in one message, so he knows exactly what he's agreeing to.

cases.situation: I'm 23 and renting my first apartment. The letting agency wants a guarantor because I'm new in my job, and I want to ask my uncle Raj. The lease is $1,800 a month for 12 months, and the agency needs an answer by Friday 9 October.
cases.reply: Hi Uncle Raj, I've found my first apartment and the agency needs a guarantor because I've only just started my job. I'd love it if that could be you, but I want to be upfront about what it means: as I read the lease, if I didn't pay, you'd be responsible for the rent, up to $21,600 over the 12 months, plus anything else the clause covers, like damage. I'll send you the guarantor clause so you can check exactly what you'd be signing. If it's not something you're comfortable with, that's completely fine, and I'll ask the agency about other options. Could you let me know by Friday 9 October?
cases.note: When a favour carries financial risk, name the worst case in numbers and share the document; hiding the size of the ask is the one thing to avoid.

cases.situation: I'm Sophie at number 14. We're having our bathroom redone from Oct 12 to Oct 16, and the builders need to put a skip outside our neighbour Mrs Dalton's front wall, which means she loses her usual parking spot for those five days. We've only said hello a few times, and she could use the space outside ours instead.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Dalton, it's Sophie from number 14. We're having our bathroom redone from Monday 12 to Friday 16 October, and the builders need to put the skip outside your front wall, which would take your usual parking spot for those five days. Would that be okay with you? You'd be very welcome to use the space outside ours while it's there. If it's a real nuisance, just say, and I'll ask the builders what else we can do.
cases.note: Name the real cost (her parking, five days), offer what you can in return, and leave a genuine out.

cases.situation: In March my friend Priya asked me to help paint her flat and I said no because of a work trip. Now my new laptop is being delivered on Tuesday Oct 6 between 9 and 1 and needs a signature, but I'll be at the office. She works from home two streets away, and I could redirect the delivery to her address and collect it that evening. It feels cheeky after I turned her down.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, a small ask, and I know I still owe you for missing the painting in March. My new laptop arrives on Tuesday Oct 6, sometime between 9 and 1, and needs a signature while I'm at the office. Could I redirect it to yours and pick it up that evening? If Tuesday's awkward, just say so, no problem at all.
cases.note: Having once said no, name it in half a line and keep the ask small; a long apology makes it heavier.

cases.situation: 我一个人在深圳工作，10月13日周二上午要在市二医院做无痛胃镜，全麻，医院要求必须有成年人陪同，做完签字再接我回家，大概早上8点到11点。想请关系不错的同事小雅帮忙，她得为这个请半天假。
cases.reply: 小雅，想请你帮个忙：我10月13日周二上午在市二医院做无痛胃镜，要全麻，医院要求必须有人陪着，做完签字再送我回家。时间大概是早上8点到11点，你得为这个请半天假，我知道不是小事。要是那天走不开，直接跟我说就好，我再问问别人。
cases.note: 时间、地点和请半天假这个代价一次说清，退路是真的；不需要解释为什么要做检查。

cases.situation: Ma fille Inès a 3 ans et mon mari Julien et moi faisons notre testament chez la notaire le 20 octobre. On voudrait demander à ma meilleure amie Camille d'être la tutrice désignée d'Inès si jamais il nous arrivait quelque chose, avec une réponse d'ici le 15 octobre. On a une assurance vie qui couvrirait ses frais, et on sait que c'est énorme à demander.
cases.reply: Camille, j'ai une grande demande, et je préfère te la faire franchement. Avec Julien, on fait notre testament chez la notaire le 20 octobre, et on aimerait te désigner comme tutrice d'Inès s'il nous arrivait quelque chose à tous les deux. Ça voudrait dire l'élever, et c'est énorme, même si notre assurance vie couvrirait ses frais. Prends le temps d'y réfléchir, et si c'est non, ça ne change rien entre nous, vraiment. Tu peux me dire d'ici le 15 octobre ?
cases.note: Plus la demande est lourde, plus il faut nommer son vrai poids et laisser du temps pour répondre.

cases.situation: My car's in the garage until Monday, and on Saturday October 3 I need to drive my mum to a hospital appointment an hour away at 10am. My friend Kate doesn't use her car at weekends. I'd need it from 8am to 2pm and would return it with a full tank, but I don't know if her insurance covers another driver; if not, I'll hire a car.
cases.reply: Hi Kate, a bigger ask than usual: could I borrow your car on Saturday 3 October, from about 8am to 2pm? Mine's in the garage and I need to drive Mum to a hospital appointment an hour away. I'd bring it back with a full tank. The one thing to check first is whether your insurance covers another driver. If it doesn't, or you'd just rather not lend it, that's completely fine and I'll hire a car.
cases.note: When the favour puts their property at risk, name the risk and let them check before they say yes.

cases.situation: I'm flying with my son Theo, who's 4, and the airline split our seats: I'm in 23C, an aisle, and he's in 25A by the window. The man in 25B is already seated. I want to ask him to swap with me so I can sit with Theo, and if he won't, I'll ask the crew.
cases.reply: Excuse me, could I ask you a favour? My son Theo, he's four, is in the window seat next to you, and I'm in 23C, an aisle seat two rows up. Would you be willing to swap so I can sit with him? If you'd rather stay put, that's completely fine and I'll ask the crew.
cases.note: With a stranger, say exactly what seat he'd be swapping into, and make the out real: the crew is the backup, not him.

cases.situation: I teach Year 4 and we're holding a careers morning on Thursday Oct 22. Mrs Okoro, the mum of one of my pupils, is a paramedic, and I'd love her to give a 20-minute talk with questions at 10am. She works shifts, and I don't want her to feel she has to say yes because I'm her son's teacher.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Okoro, we're holding a careers morning for Year 4 on Thursday 22 October, and I'd love to ask whether you'd come in and talk about being a paramedic. It would be about 20 minutes at 10am, including the children's questions. I know you work shifts, so if the day doesn't fit, or it's simply not your thing, that's completely fine and it won't change a thing. Thank you for considering it.
cases.note: From a child's teacher, a parent may feel a no is risky, so the out has to say outright that nothing changes.

cases.situation: 我10月12日到25日去德国出差。我爸78岁，一个人住，楼下的李阿姨跟他很熟，也有我的微信。想请她这两周每天下午敲门看一眼我爸，大概五分钟。
cases.reply: 李阿姨，想请您帮个忙：我10月12日到25日去德国出差，我爸一个人在家。这两周您方便的话，每天下午敲门看他一眼，五分钟就够，看到他好好的给我发个微信说一声。万一敲门没人应，或者他看着不舒服，请直接打120，再跟我说。那段时间要是不方便，完全没关系，直接告诉我，我再想别的办法。
cases.note: 请邻居照看老人：每天做什么、花多久说清楚，紧急情况先打120写在明处，再给一个真的退路。

cases.situation: 好朋友小雯在香港出差，10月20日（周二）回上海，出差期间住酒店。我想请她帮我带一套英文绘本回来，我在网上下单直接寄到她酒店，书钱我自己付。整套大概3公斤，挺占行李箱的。
cases.reply: 雯雯，你20号从香港回来对吧？想请你帮个忙：帮我带一套英文绘本，我在网上下单直接寄到你酒店，钱我来付，你只要装进箱子就行。整套大概3公斤，挺占地方的，行李要是满了或者不方便，直接说不行就好，我再想别的办法。
cases.note: 把重量和占地方说在前面，她才能真正自由地说不。

cases.situation: 我10月10日到19日一个人去新疆徒步，山里大部分时候没有手机信号，我带了卫星通讯器。想请好朋友阿琳当我的紧急联系人：每天晚上9点前我给她发消息报平安；超过24小时没消息，就请她按我发给她的行程单打110报警，再联系我姐姐。
cases.reply: 阿琳，想请你帮个比较重要的忙：我10月10日到19日一个人去新疆徒步，想请你当我的紧急联系人。具体是这样：每天晚上9点前，我用卫星通讯器给你发一条报平安；如果超过24小时没收到消息，请你按我发你的行程单打110报警，然后联系我姐姐。这十天你都得留意手机，是个不小的负担。你要是觉得压力大，或者那几天不方便，直接说就好，我再找别人。
cases.note: 当紧急联系人是一份责任：触发条件和要打的电话写清楚，报警这一步明确写出来，她就不用临场判断。

cases.situation: I move out of my flat on Saturday October 31 and won't get the keys to my new place until early February. My friend Jonah has a garage he barely uses, and I'd like to store 12 boxes and my bike there for about three months, brought over in one trip on the 31st. If he can't, I'll book a storage unit.
cases.reply: Hi Jonah, a bigger ask than usual: could I store some things in your garage for about three months? I move out on Saturday 31 October and don't get the keys to the new place until early February. It's 12 boxes and my bike, and I'd bring it all over in one trip on the 31st and not need to get at it until I move. If you need the space or it's just a hassle, say so, no problem at all, and I'll book a storage unit.
cases.note: A long favour is easy to say yes to when the end date, the amount of space and how often you'll need access are all spelled out.

cases.situation: 我爸三月去世了，老房子要在10月底前清空交给买家。10月10日（周六）我要回去收拾他的遗物，一个人去有点撑不住。想请大学室友阿珍陪我一天，帮忙搬箱子，大概早上9点到下午5点，她住的地方开车过去要40分钟。
cases.reply: 阿珍，想请你帮个忙，有点重：10月10日周六我要回老房子收拾我爸的东西，房子月底前要交出去。我一个人去怕撑不住，想请你陪我一天，大概早上9点到下午5点，主要是搬箱子，还有就是身边有个人。你开车过去要40分钟，又占一整个周六，不方便就直接说，我完全理解，再想别的安排。
cases.note: 情感上的请求也要说清时间和要做的事，对方才知道自己答应的是什么。

cases.situation: Our cat Pepper, a grey tabby with a white chest, has been missing since Sunday night. The corner café on our street has a noticeboard by the till; I don't know the owner, but I've made an A5 poster. I want to ask in person if I can pin it up for two weeks.
cases.reply: Hi, could I ask you something quickly? Our cat Pepper, a grey tabby with a white chest, has been missing since Sunday night. Would it be okay to pin this A5 poster on your noticeboard by the till for two weeks? I'll come back and take it down myself after that. If the board's full or you'd rather not, no problem at all.
cases.note: A stranger owes you nothing: keep it small, time-limited, and promise to clear up after yourself.

cases.situation: I'm away Friday 16 to Sunday 18 October for my sister's wedding. My dog Bruno, a 6-year-old rescue, is nervous around other dogs, needs two 30-minute walks a day on a lead, and takes one pill with breakfast. I want to ask my friend Lucy, who's met him and has no pets, to have him at hers; I'd drop him off at 8am Friday and collect him at 7pm Sunday, and if not I'll book a kennel.
cases.reply: Hi Lucy, a big-ish ask: could Bruno stay with you from Friday 16 to Sunday 18 October while I'm at my sister's wedding? I'd drop him off at 8am Friday and pick him up at 7pm Sunday. To be upfront, he's nervous around other dogs, so it's two 30-minute walks a day on the lead, steering clear of other dogs, plus one pill with breakfast. If that's more than you want to take on, just say, and I'll book a kennel. I'll bring his food, his bed and a written list.
cases.note: Name the hard part of the favour before they agree; a yes given without knowing the dog is nervous isn't a real yes.

cases.situation: 我奶奶82岁，一直想学用微信跟在国外的小姑视频，还想学用手机买菜，不过她学东西慢，同一步要讲好几遍。表弟小凯在读大学，国庆在家，10月5日（周一）下午有空。想请他那天下午花两个小时教教奶奶，教完我请他吃饭；他没空的话我自己慢慢教。
cases.reply: 小凯，想请你帮个忙，正好是你拿手的：奶奶一直想学用微信跟小姑视频，还想学用手机买菜。你10月5日周一下午要是有空，能不能花两个小时教教她？先跟你说清楚，奶奶学得慢，同一步可能要讲好几遍。不方便也完全没关系，我自己慢慢教。教完我请你吃饭。
cases.note: 替家人开口求助：说清帮谁、做什么、花多久、难在哪，再给一个真的退路。

cases.situation: I'm meeting my girlfriend Jiwoo's grandparents in Busan on Saturday 24 October and I've written a five-sentence hello in Korean myself with a dictionary. My coworker Hana in finance is a native Korean speaker, but we've only worked on one project together. I'd like her to check it and maybe record a voice note of how it sounds, about 15 minutes; if not, I'll book a session with a tutor, and I'd buy her a coffee either way.
cases.reply: Hi Hana, a slightly personal ask, so feel free to say no: I'm meeting my girlfriend Jiwoo's grandparents in Busan on 24 October, and I've written a five-sentence hello in Korean with a dictionary. Would you have about 15 minutes to check it, and maybe record a quick voice note so I can hear how it should sound? If you're swamped or would rather not, no problem at all, I'll book a session with a tutor. Coffee's on me either way.
cases.note: Asking someone you barely know to use their language for you: say it's personal, cap the time, and have a paid backup ready.

cases.situation: Abro mi panadería, Miga Lenta, en Sevilla el sábado 17 de octubre. Mi amiga del instituto Lucía tiene 40.000 seguidores en su Instagram de recetas, y me gustaría pedirle que compartiera una story ese día con una foto que le mando yo. No quiero que se sienta obligada ni que parezca un anuncio, y le quiero llevar una caja de bollos de todas formas.
cases.reply: Lucía, te quiero pedir un favor, y si no te encaja, dime que no sin ningún problema. El sábado 17 de octubre abro Miga Lenta y me haría muchísima ilusión que compartieras una story ese día; yo te paso la foto, así que serían dos minutos. Solo si te apetece de verdad: la cuenta es tuya y entiendo perfectamente que no quieras mezclar. Y la caja de bollos te la llevo igual, faltaría más.
cases.note: Cuando el favor es prestar tu reputación, la salida tiene que ser explícita y el regalo, independiente de la respuesta.

cases.situation: I'm 71 and just bought a new phone. My son Daniel lives 20 minutes away and works long hours, and I'd like him to help me set it up and move my contacts and photos from the old one, about an hour, on Saturday or Sunday afternoon. If he's busy, the shop offers a paid setup, and I'd like to make him his favourite lasagne either way.
cases.reply: Hi love, a small ask, and say no if your weekend's full. I've got my new phone and I'd like some help setting it up and moving my contacts and photos across from the old one. I think it's about an hour. Could you pop round Saturday or Sunday afternoon? If you're too busy, no problem at all, the shop does a paid setup and I'll book that. Either way, there's a lasagne with your name on it.
cases.note: Parents asking grown children need the same clear size and real out; it stops a small ask feeling like a duty.

cases.situation: I'm Owen in flat 2. Our remortgage deed has to be signed in front of a witness, and the lender's instructions say it must be an adult who isn't family or living with us, who watches me sign and then adds their own name, address and signature. I want to ask my neighbour Grace in flat 4; it takes about 10 minutes, any evening before Thursday, and if she can't I'll ask a colleague at work.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, it's Owen from flat 2. Could I ask a small favour? Our remortgage deed needs a witness who isn't family, which means watching me sign and then adding your name, address and signature. It takes about 10 minutes, any evening before Thursday that suits you. If you'd rather not, no problem at all, I'll ask someone at work.
cases.note: Say exactly what witnessing involves, including that their address goes on the form, so the yes is informed.

cases.situation: Ich ziehe im Dezember von Hamburg nach München und habe am Dienstag, 13. Oktober, um 18 Uhr eine Wohnungsbesichtigung in Schwabing, kann aber nicht hinfahren. Mein früherer Mitbewohner Jonas wohnt zehn Minuten entfernt; ich möchte ihn bitten, sich die Wohnung etwa 45 Minuten lang anzusehen und ein paar Videos zu machen. Wenn er nicht kann, frage ich die Maklerin nach einer Videobesichtigung, und beim nächsten Besuch lade ich ihn zum Essen ein.
cases.reply: Hey Jonas, ich hätte eine Bitte, und sag ruhig ab, wenn es nicht passt: Ich habe am Dienstag, 13. Oktober, um 18 Uhr eine Wohnungsbesichtigung in Schwabing, zehn Minuten von dir, und schaffe es aus Hamburg nicht hin. Könntest du dir die Wohnung für mich ansehen und ein paar Videos machen? Das wären etwa 45 Minuten. Wenn es nicht klappt, kein Problem, dann frage ich die Maklerin nach einer Videobesichtigung. So oder so lade ich dich zum Essen ein, wenn ich das nächste Mal in München bin.
cases.note: Zeit, Ort und Aufwand stehen in einer Nachricht, und der Plan B nimmt ihm den Druck.

cases.situation: 我在读研二，毕业论文在做城市通勤的研究，问卷链接已经做好了：12道题，大约5分钟，匿名，不收集手机号，10月16日（周五）截止。想发到本科校友群里（300多人，大部分不认识我），填过的人想看的话，论文完成后我把结论摘要发给他们。
cases.reply: 各位校友好，我是正在读研二的校友，想请大家帮个小忙：我的毕业论文在做城市通勤的研究，需要一份问卷，12道题，大约5分钟，匿名填写，不收集手机号。10月16日（周五）截止，链接放在下面。没时间或者不感兴趣的话直接划过就好，完全没关系。填过的朋友如果想看结论，私信我，论文完成后我把摘要发给你。
cases.note: 向一群陌生人求助：一次说清花多久、收不收个人信息、截止哪天，不点名、不催，划过去就当没看见。

cases.situation: 我12月12日（周六）在成都办婚礼，想请大学室友小棠当伴娘。要做的是：前一天下午彩排两小时，当天早上6点到酒店化妆，一直陪到晚上9点左右。伴娘服我来买，她从重庆过来的高铁票和前一晚的酒店我也出。她刚换工作，不知道请假方不方便，就算不当伴娘，我也很希望她来参加婚礼。
cases.reply: 小棠，想请你帮个大忙：我12月12日（周六）在成都办婚礼，想请你当我的伴娘。先把要做的事说清楚：前一天下午彩排两个小时，当天早上6点到酒店化妆，一直陪到晚上9点左右，是挺累的一整天。伴娘服我来买，你从重庆过来的高铁票和前一晚的酒店也都我来出。你刚换工作，要是请假不方便，或者就是不想折腾，直接说就好，完全不影响我们的关系，你能来参加婚礼我就很开心了。
cases.note: 当伴娘是要占两天的大请求：时间、累的程度、谁出钱一次说清，退路要真，别让她为拒绝内疚。
